name: PTS-4077F
title: PTS-4077F Directional Tile Speaker
description: 2x2 directional ceiling tile speaker with DAC technology. 96dB sensitivity, Cat5 plug-and-play.
detailTitle: PTS-4077F Directional Tile Array Speaker with DAC
detailDescription: The PTS-4077F is a high-performance focused tile-array active speaker with Defined Acoustic Coverage (DAC). It creates a well-defined audio zone while eliminating sound bleeding into adjacent areas, offering the best low-frequency response of any directional speaker in the industry.

specifications.value: Cat5 (300 ft max to PH-1AA hub)

features: Innovative design with highly focused directional sound
Defined Acoustic Coverage - eliminates sound bleeding to adjacent zones
Greatest low-frequency capability of any directional speaker
Retrofit friendly - quick and easy to install
applications: Healthcare waiting areas and POP displays
Hotels, fitness clubs, restaurants, theme parks
